name: claude-mem
what: Persistent memory across agent sessions: hooks, a background worker, search and timelines.

install.why: registers the hooks and starts the worker; it may ask you to sign in. Pass --provider, or set CLAUDE_MEM_ONLINE_OPTIN=false, to skip sign-in. For another IDE add --ide <name>. Do not use `npm install -g claude-mem`: that installs only the library

after: Restart the agent so the hooks load.
